thematicAnalysis: Human vitality culminates when raw sensory consciousness (*sentire*) actively seizes the fleeting immediacy of the present (*carpe diem*) rather than deferring purpose to an abstract future. This somatic engagement manifests both internally as an aesthetic shudder of awe (*frisson*) and interpersonally as an overflowing, radiant celebration of another's flourishing (*kvell*).
quote: We should consider every day lost on which we have not danced at least once.
author: Friedrich Nietzsche
synthesisNote: Nietzsche’s demand to translate each day into physical dance exemplifies how felt sensory awareness and temporal urgency crystallize into ecstatic, embodied joy.
